newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway central bank lowers 1997 CPI forecast.
newsitem.headline: Norway central bank lowers 1997 CPI forecast.

text.p: Norway's central bank, Norges Bank, revised downwards its forecast for inflation in 1997, but warned of growing pressures in the economy leading to a risk of higher inflation in the longer term.

In a quarterly inflation report, the bank projected consumer price inflation this year at 2.5 percent compared with an estimate of 2.75 percent in its March report, primarily due to lower-than-expected electricity prices.
For 1998, Norges Bank left unchaged its outlook for growth in consumer prices at 2.0 percent.
